title: Shanghai Local Guide
subtitle: The city that brings us together
subtitleCn: 将我们聚在一起的城市

locations.name: Xintiandi Food Hall
locations.description: A convenient stop for trying multiple Shanghainese and international bites in one area.
locations.descriptionCn: 在一个区域内体验多种本帮与国际风味，适合初到上海的轻松尝试。
locations.address: Lane 181, Taicang Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区太仓路181弄
tips: Go before 7pm to avoid dinner queues
Most vendors support Alipay and WeChat Pay
tipsCn: 建议晚7点前到达，避免排队
多数商户支持支付宝和微信支付

locations.name: Fuxing Park
locations.description: A classic urban park for morning walks and people-watching in the former French Concession.
locations.descriptionCn: 法租界核心区域的经典城市公园，适合晨间散步与观察本地生活。
locations.address: No. 516 Fuxing Middle Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区复兴中路516号
tips: Best visited in the morning
Bring water in warmer months
tipsCn: 建议上午前往体验更佳
夏季请准备饮用水

locations.name: Rockbund Art Museum
locations.description: Contemporary art exhibitions in a historic Bund building with thoughtful curatorial programs.
locations.descriptionCn: 在历史建筑中呈现当代艺术展览，策展项目具有持续的公共讨论价值。
locations.address: No. 20 Huqiu Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区虎丘路20号
tips: Check exhibition schedule before arrival
Plan 60-90 minutes for one visit
tipsCn: 建议出发前查看展览档期
单次参观建议预留60-90分钟

locations.name: Shanghai Museum East
locations.description: A major museum destination featuring Chinese art, design, and rotating special exhibits.
locations.descriptionCn: 重要博物馆目的地，涵盖中国艺术、设计及阶段性专题展。
locations.address: No. 1952 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
locations.addressCn: 上海市浦东新区世纪大道1952号
tips: Reserve timed entry when available
Audio guides are helpful for first-time visitors
tipsCn: 如可预约请提前选择入场时段
首次参观建议租用语音讲解

locations.name: Ruijin Hospital International Clinic
locations.description: Reliable medical support option for visitors needing consultation or urgent care guidance.
locations.descriptionCn: 适合临时就诊与健康咨询的稳定医疗支持点。
locations.address: No. 197 Ruijin Er Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区瑞金二路197号
tips: Bring passport for registration
International clinic hours differ from general outpatient
tipsCn: 挂号请携带护照
国际门诊与普通门诊开放时间不同

locations.name: Bank of China Lujiazui Branch
locations.description: A central banking branch useful for account service and cross-border card support.
locations.descriptionCn: 位于核心商务区，适合办理账户与跨境银行卡相关业务。
locations.address: No. 58 Yincheng Middle Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
locations.addressCn: 上海市浦东新区银城中路58号
tips: Weekday mornings are usually faster
Bring ID and local phone number if opening an account
tipsCn: 工作日上午通常排队更短
开户请准备证件与本地手机号

locations.name: Longyang Road Metro Hub
locations.description: Major transit interchange connecting metro lines and Maglev for airport access.
locations.descriptionCn: 连接多条地铁线路及磁悬浮的核心交通换乘点。
locations.address: Longyang Road Station, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
locations.addressCn: 上海市浦东新区龙阳路站
tips: Top up transit card before rush hour
Follow signs carefully for Maglev transfer
tipsCn: 建议在高峰前完成交通卡充值
前往磁悬浮请留意换乘指引

locations.name: Jing'an Jazz House
locations.description: An intimate live music venue popular with international residents and local creatives.
locations.descriptionCn: 氛围轻松的现场音乐空间，常有国际社群与本地创作者聚集。
locations.address: No. 88 Kangding Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai
locations.addressCn: 上海市静安区康定路88号
tips: Reserve seats on weekends
Cashless payment is standard
tipsCn: 周末建议提前订位
店内通常采用无现金支付

locations.name: M50 Creative Park
locations.description: A cluster of galleries and studios showcasing emerging contemporary artists.
locations.descriptionCn: 集合画廊与工作室的当代艺术聚落，适合了解新锐创作。
locations.address: No. 50 Moganshan Road, Putuo District, Shanghai
locations.addressCn: 上海市普陀区莫干山路50号
tips: Some galleries close on Mondays
Wear comfortable shoes for walking between buildings
tipsCn: 部分画廊周一闭馆
园区步行较多，建议穿舒适鞋

locations.name: Lost Heaven Yunnan
locations.description: Landmark Yunnan restaurant on the Bund strip serving bold folk cuisine — wild mushrooms, crossing-the-bridge noodles, minority-inspired dishes in colonial-era interior.
locations.descriptionCn: 位于外滩附近的标志性云南餐厅，以西南少数民族风味菜肴著称，包括野生菌、过桥米线等，室内装潢融合殖民地建筑风格。
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区延安东路17号
tips: Book 3 days ahead for weekend dinners
Order the Yunnan ham platter and Dai-style grilled fish
Lunch is 30% cheaper and easier to walk into
tipsCn: 周末晚餐至少提前3天预订
必点云南火腿拼盘和傣式烤鱼
午餐更便宜且容易入座

locations.name: Ultraviolet by Paul Pairet
locations.description: World's most immersive dining — 10-seat table, each course synchronized with visuals/sound/scent. Three Michelin stars. Secret location.
locations.descriptionCn: 全球最具沉浸感的餐厅，仅10个座位，每道菜配合投影、音效与香氛，米其林三星。地址保密。
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区（具体地址预订后告知）
tips: Reservations open months in advance — join waitlist immediately
20 courses over 3 hours, arrive hungry
Smart casual dress code
tipsCn: 预订需提前数月，请立即加入候补名单
约20道菜历时3小时，请空腹赴约
着装要求商务休闲

locations.name: Yang's Fried Dumplings (Huanghe Road)
locations.description: Shanghai's most iconic sheng jian bao — crispy bottoms, soup-filled interiors. The Huanghe Road flagship is the original.
locations.descriptionCn: 上海最具代表性的生煎馒头，底部酥脆、内含鲜汤。黄河路总店是发源地。
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区黄河路54号
tips: Order at window, pay first, wait for number
4 buns per order, get 2 orders + beef soup
Before 11AM or after 2PM avoids longest queues
tipsCn: 窗口点单先付款，等叫号
标准份4个，建议点两份配牛肉汤
上午11点前或下午2点后避开最长排队

locations.name: Egg (Brunch Cafe)
locations.description: French Concession brunch institution with sunny courtyard, excellent eggs Benedict, seasonal menu drawing expats and locals every weekend.
locations.descriptionCn: 法租界深受喜爱的早午餐名店，拥有阳光庭院，班尼迪克蛋系列出色，周末吸引大批食客。
locations.addressCn: 上海市徐汇区永福路68号
tips: Arrive by 10AM weekends or expect 30-45 min wait
Courtyard seats first-come
House granola and cold brew worth adding
tipsCn: 周末10点前到达避免等候
庭院座位先到先得
自制格兰诺拉和冷萃值得加点

locations.name: Wu Yue Ren Jia (Late-Night)
locations.description: No-frills Jiangnan supper spot open past midnight — drunken chicken, braised pork belly, river shrimp. Post-bar favorite.
locations.descriptionCn: 朴实的江南风味宵夜馆，营业至午夜后，醉鸡、红烧肉和河虾是招牌。
locations.addressCn: 上海市徐汇区桃江路1号
tips: Kitchen open until 2AM most nights
Must order: drunken chicken and scallion oil noodles
Cash and WeChat Pay, no English menu
tipsCn: 厨房通常营业至凌晨2点
必点醉鸡和葱油拌面
支持现金和微信支付，无英文菜单

locations.name: Yu Garden
locations.description: Ming Dynasty classical garden (1559) — rockeries, pavilions, koi ponds, ornate corridors. Surrounded by the Yu Garden Bazaar.
locations.descriptionCn: 建于1559年的明代古典园林，假山、亭台、锦鲤池与雕花回廊相映成趣，周边豫园商城热闹非凡。
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区安仁街218号
tips: Weekday morning before 9AM avoids tour groups
Find the Exquisite Jade Rock in Inner Garden
Combine with Old City Mosque and Nanshi area
tipsCn: 工作日早晨9点前避开旅行团
内园玉玲珑不可错过
可结合老城隍庙和南市一带

locations.name: China Art Museum
locations.description: Housed in the red China Pavilion from Expo 2010. World's largest modern Chinese art collection across 27 galleries. Free.
locations.descriptionCn: 坐落于2010年世博会中国馆内，拥有27个展厅，是全球最大的中国近现代美术收藏机构。免费。
locations.addressCn: 上海市浦东新区上南路205号
tips: Free admission, bring passport
Republican-era paintings on floors 4-5 are world-class
Allow at least 3 hours
tipsCn: 免费入场，需凭护照
4至5楼民国油画水准极高
建议预留至少3小时

locations.name: Shanghai Grand Theatre
locations.description: Premier performing arts venue with curved glass roof by Charpentier. World-class opera, ballet, orchestral year-round.
locations.descriptionCn: 法国建筑师夏邦杰设计的顶级表演艺术场馆，弧形玻璃屋顶独特，全年上演世界级演出。
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区人民大道300号
tips: Check website for touring international companies
Pre-show dinner at in-house restaurant
Stunning at night even without tickets
tipsCn: 关注官网国际院团巡演
剧院内餐厅可用演前晚餐
夜晚灯光效果即使无票也值得一看

locations.name: Shanghai Jewish Refugees Museum
locations.description: In restored Ohel Moshe Synagogue (1927). Documents 20,000 Jewish refugees who found sanctuary in Shanghai during WWII.
locations.descriptionCn: 坐落于修缮一新的摩西会堂（1927年），记录二战期间两万名犹太难民在虹口区获得庇护的历史。
locations.addressCn: 上海市虹口区长阳路62号
tips: Audio guide essential — many exhibits Chinese only
Allow 90 minutes
Combine with Tilanqiao Historic District walk
tipsCn: 语音导览必不可少
建议预留90分钟
可结合提篮桥历史街区游览

locations.name: Power Station of Art
locations.description: China's first state-run contemporary art museum, converted from Expo power plant. 165m chimney landmark. Hosts Shanghai Biennale.
locations.descriptionCn: 中国首家国有当代艺术博物馆，由世博会发电厂改建，165米烟囱是地标，每两年举办上海双年展。
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区花园港路200号
tips: Free first Sunday of month, otherwise ¥20
Chimney deck has best Huangpu views
Biennale years (even) draw major international artists
tipsCn: 每月第一个周日免费，其余20元
烟囱观景台俯瞰黄浦江最佳
双年展年份有重量级国际艺术家

locations.name: West Bund Museum
locations.description: Centre Pompidou collaboration on the West Bund cultural corridor. Rotating Pompidou collection + contemporary shows.
locations.descriptionCn: 西岸文化走廊与蓬皮杜中心合作项目，定期展出蓬皮杜永久藏品及当代艺术展览。
locations.addressCn: 上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2555号
tips: West Bund corridor connects PSA, this, and Tank Shanghai — plan full day
Book timed tickets online
Riverside promenade excellent at sunset
tipsCn: 西岸走廊串联PSA、本馆和油罐艺术中心，适合整天
需提前网上预约分时票
馆外滨江步道日落体验极佳

locations.name: UCCA Edge
locations.nameCn: UCCA Edge尤伦斯当代艺术中心
locations.description: Shanghai outpost of Beijing's UCCA. 30-story tower on Suzhou Creek. Cutting-edge contemporary, younger artists.
locations.descriptionCn: 北京尤伦斯当代艺术中心上海分馆，苏州河畔30层综合体，聚焦前沿当代艺术。
locations.addressCn: 上海市普陀区澳门路88号
tips: Arrive from Suzhou Creek side for best approach
More experimental than West Bund institutions
M50 is nearby — combine visits
tipsCn: 从苏州河一侧入场视觉冲击最强
比西岸机构更实验性
M50就在附近可一同游览

locations.name: The Bund (Waitan)
locations.description: Shanghai's most iconic waterfront — 1.5km of Art Deco facades facing Pudong skyline. Best at dawn or dusk.
locations.descriptionCn: 上海最具标志性的滨水长廊，1.5公里装饰艺术建筑群与浦东天际线隔江相望，清晨或黄昏最迷人。
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区中山东一路
tips: Dawn 6-7AM is nearly empty with extraordinary light
Elevated platform near Chenyi Square for best panorama
Walk north to Rockbund for quieter experience
tipsCn: 清晨6至7点几乎无人，光线绝美
陈毅广场观景台视角最佳
向北至外滩源更安静

locations.name: Century Park
locations.description: Pudong's largest green lung — 140 hectares, central lake, cycling paths, seasonal flower displays. Families and tai chi mornings.
locations.descriptionCn: 浦东最大绿色空间，140公顷，中央湖泊、骑行道与四季花卉，家庭和晨练太极圣地。
locations.addressCn: 上海市浦东新区锦绣路1001号
tips: Rent bikes at east gate ¥20/hour, lake loop ~5km
Summer outdoor concerts
Same metro stop as Science & Technology Museum
tipsCn: 东门租车约20元/小时，绕湖约5公里
夏季有户外音乐会
与科技馆同一地铁站

locations.name: Jing'an Park
locations.description: Compact beloved urban park — small lake, mature plane trees, morning retirees dancing, chess, calligraphy.
locations.descriptionCn: 小巧而深受喜爱的城市公园，小湖、法国梧桐与晨间退休市民跳舞下棋练书法的生动场景。
locations.addressCn: 上海市静安区华山路189号
tips: Visit 7-9AM for authentic morning culture
Adjacent to Jing'an Temple — combine both
Free entry, small cafe inside
tipsCn: 早7至9点亲历上海晨间文化
紧邻静安寺可合并游览
免费入场，园内有小咖啡馆

locations.name: Huangpu River Waterfront (Xuhui)
locations.description: 8.4km regenerated industrial shoreline — art institutions, pop-up cafes, river views. West Bund cultural corridor backbone.
locations.descriptionCn: 8.4公里再生工业岸线，艺术机构、快闪咖啡馆与开阔江景，西岸文化走廊核心。
locations.addressCn: 上海市徐汇区龙腾大道
tips: West Bund Museum to Tank Shanghai is best 2km
Sunset toward Lupu Bridge is one of Shanghai's best free views
Bike rentals available, full ride ~45 min
tipsCn: 西岸美术馆至油罐艺术中心这2公里最精华
眺望卢浦大桥的日落是上海最美免费风景
可骑共享单车，全程约45分钟

locations.name: Naked Hub (Xintiandi)
locations.description: Design-forward coworking — hot desks, private offices, events, strong international professional community.
locations.descriptionCn: 设计感联合办公，共享工位、独立办公室、活动场地，国际专业人士社群活跃。
locations.addressCn: 上海市徐汇区天钥桥路333号
tips: Day passes available without membership
Community events useful for building Shanghai network
High-speed fiber, standing desks, good coffee
tipsCn: 无需会员可购日票
社区活动适合建立上海人脉
高速光纤、升降桌和优质咖啡

locations.name: Parkway Health Medical Centre (Jing'an)
locations.description: Established international healthcare — English-speaking GPs, specialists, full diagnostics. Expat go-to.
locations.descriptionCn: 上海最具口碑的国际医疗机构，英语全科医生、专科医生及完整诊断服务。
locations.addressCn: 上海市静安区南京西路1376号
tips: Accepts most international insurance directly
Online appointment in English, same-day GP often available
24-hour emergency line
tipsCn: 直接接受大多数国际保险
可在线英文预约，全科当天号源常有
提供24小时紧急热线

locations.name: Speak Low
locations.description: Asia's 50 Best Bars regular — three-floor speakeasy behind cocktail supply shop. Inventive, precise, atmospheric.
locations.descriptionCn: 长期跻身亚洲50最佳酒吧，藏身调酒用品店后方的三层地下酒吧，创意十足、精准考究。
locations.addressCn: 上海市静安区富民路579号
tips: Enter through cocktail supply shop — bar behind shelves
No reservations, arrive before 9PM weekends
Ask bartenders for off-menu recommendations
tipsCn: 入口在调酒用品店内，穿过货架
不接受预订，周末9点前到
可请调酒师推荐菜单外特调

locations.name: Senator Saloon
locations.description: French Concession institution — wood-paneled American saloon, exceptional whiskey (200+ bottles), loyal expat crowd.
locations.descriptionCn: 法租界经典酒吧，美式木质装潢，威士忌超200款，深受外籍常客喜爱。
locations.addressCn: 上海市徐汇区永嘉路590号
tips: Ask for hidden shelf selections behind bar
Live music Thu and Sat — arrive by 9PM
Chili cheese fries are genuinely good late-night food
tipsCn: 询问吧台后方隐藏货架特选
周四周六有现场音乐，9点前到
辣椒芝士薯条是好吃的宵夜

locations.name: Shelter
locations.description: Legendary underground club in WWII bomb shelter — raw concrete, world-class sound, global electronic acts for 10+ years.
locations.descriptionCn: 传奇地下俱乐部，二战防空洞改建，原始混凝土配世界级音响，十余年持续引进全球电子音乐。
locations.addressCn: 上海市徐汇区永福路5号
tips: Check weekly lineup on WeChat or RA
Genuinely underground — dress for warmth in winter
Doors 10PM, real energy after midnight
tipsCn: 通过微信或RA查看每周阵容
真的在地下，冬天注意保暖
10点开门，午夜后最佳

locations.name: Bar Rouge (Rooftop)
locations.description: The Bund's most glamorous rooftop — 7F of Bund 18, floor-to-ceiling windows, Pudong skyline terrace. Power-view cocktails.
locations.descriptionCn: 外滩最具魅力的屋顶酒吧，外滩18号7楼，落地窗与露台直面浦东天际线。
locations.addressCn: 上海市黄浦区中山东一路18号7楼
tips: Terrace fills fast after 9PM weekends — arrive early
Cocktails ¥120-180 but view justifies one drink
Weekend dress code: smart casual minimum
tipsCn: 周末9点后露台迅速爆满，建议早到
鸡尾酒120至180元但景色值一杯
周末有着装要求，至少商务休闲

walks.name: Bund to West Art Loop
walks.nameCn: 外滩到西区艺术步行线
walks.description: A half-day route linking riverside heritage, museum visits, and creative studios.
walks.descriptionCn: 半日路线，串联江边历史风貌、博物馆参观与创意园区体验。

walks.name: Bund to French Concession
walks.description: Shanghai's classic urban transect — colonial Bund through Nanjing Road, People's Square, Xintiandi, into leafy French Concession.
walks.descriptionCn: 上海最经典的城市横断面——从外滩殖民建筑群穿越南京路、人民广场、新天地，抵达法租界梧桐小道。

walks.name: Art Shanghai
walks.description: Pilgrimage through Shanghai's contemporary art corridor — PSA on the Huangpu, along West Bund waterfront, to M50 on Suzhou Creek.
walks.descriptionCn: 穿越上海当代艺术走廊——从黄浦江畔PSA沿西岸滨江步道至苏州河边M50。
